# aibris v0.13.0

This release adds a single deletion safety gate, covers two more large AI and
package-manager stores, makes guided worktree review several times faster, and
cleans up what `scan` prints.

## Highlights

- **One deletion gate** (#572). Every recursive deletion, cleanup command, and
  `git worktree remove` now passes `internal/safedelete`, the only code allowed
  to call `os.RemoveAll`. It refuses anything outside `$HOME`, protected
  locations and their ancestors (`~/Documents`, `~/Library`, `~/.ssh`,
  `~/.config`, cloud-sync folders, each AI tool's home, agent stores and
  worktree containers, including relocated `CODEX_HOME` / `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`
  homes), primary Git repositories, and Git metadata. Cleanup commands run with
  their cache location pinned to the scanned path.
- **Grok CLI sessions** (#578). `~/.grok/sessions/<url-encoded cwd>/` entries
  are cleaned when proven orphaned: the encoded name and every session's
  recorded `working_directory` must agree and that directory must be gone.
  Agent-state cleanup now also re-checks in-store activity against
  `--agent-state-grace` right before removal (Claude and Cursor included).
- **Cache catalog** (#576). Build and Python caches come from one catalog that
  follows platform defaults; the macOS pip cache is found at
  `~/Library/Caches/pip`; the `npx` cache is a new target.
- **Faster guided review** (#573). Git evidence is gathered once and
  concurrently; with 12 worktrees `clean --dry-run --guide` went from 13-19s to
  3-9s.
- **Quieter, clearer output** (#577, #579). Scan progress goes to stderr and
  is silent when not a terminal; the scan summary shows each number once in
  one aligned column (`found`, `reclaimable`, `held back`, `volume`).
- **Docs** (#575). The README leads with what aibris does; install trust and
  artifact verification moved to `docs/INSTALL.md`; `AGENTS.md` is in English
  with a product direction; private vulnerability reporting is enabled.

## Compatibility impact

- [x] **Compatible addition.** New `tool` value `grok` for agent-state items
  and new cache `id` value `npx`. Existing JSON fields, flags, defaults, and
  exit behavior are unchanged. Human-readable output changed; it is not a
  compatibility contract (see `docs/COMPATIBILITY.md`).

## Upgrade and migration

No flag migration is required.

```bash
brew upgrade aibris
# or (Unix):
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sungjunlee/aibris/refs/heads/main/install.sh | bash -s -- v0.13.0
# or (Windows PowerShell):
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sungjunlee/aibris/refs/heads/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Scripts that parsed the human `scan` summary (for example the
`default clean (estimate)` line) should read `scan --json` instead.

## Safety

- The new gate is an additional layer; every earlier safeguard (dry-run and
  confirmation, `--risky`, active-worktree protection, agent-state proof and
  revalidation, snapshot identity checks, overlap safety, strip
  re-authorization) is unchanged.
- Grok entries with any unreadable or disagreeing session, or whose recorded
  directory sits on an unavailable volume, stay `undetermined` and are never
  selected.
- Known limitations: `brew cleanup --prune=all` also removes old kegs (the
  existing Homebrew behavior), and Git metadata relocated under another name
  with `--separate-git-dir` is not detected by path.

## Windows status

Unchanged from v0.12.3: Windows native support is installable and
reproducible (`install.ps1`, case-insensitive path canonicalization, and the
`windows-safety` CI job). Real vendor agent worktree layouts on Windows,
end-to-end delete mutation, and native arm64 execution remain experimental and
unmeasured. See `docs/WINDOWS.md`.
